name: H1: Diagnostic — Is rank-1 from CRPS or architecture?
theory: Output rank 1.57 in both 99m_v2 and 120b despite completely restructured noise. Add log-det(Cov(ensemble)) penalty to loss. If rank increases: CRPS is the bottleneck (proceed to H2). If rank stays ~1: architecture is fundamentally rank-limited (skip to H3).
prediction: Expect effective rank to increase to 2.0+ if CRPS is the sole cause of rank-1. If architecture caps it, rank stays <2.0 even with lambda_rank=1.0.
falsification: rank < 2.0 even with lambda_rank=1.0 → architecture fundamentally rank-limited
implementation: Add log-det penalty: loss += lambda_rank * (-log(det(Cov(ensemble))) or equivalently -sum(log(eigenvalues))). Train 5 epochs. Measure effective rank of ensemble output.
info_value: HIGHEST — answer redirects all future effort

name: H2: Variogram Score as minimal correlation signal
theory: CRPS has zero cross-cell gradient (Sklar). VS targets pairwise differences (orthogonal to CRPS). Three prior aux losses fought CRPS but they targeted temporal properties (VR, ACF), not spatial. VS operates on a different axis — shouldn't trigger tug-of-war.
target: Cross-cell correlation structure, Suite 2 per-cell CI
prediction: Effective rank increases beyond what H1 achieved. Cross-cell correlation moves toward GT (~0.38).
falsification: rank < 1.5 AND correlation unchanged → VS gradient too weak (same as Pattern B)
implementation: Add lambda_vario * VS_0.5 to loss. No architecture changes. VS = (1/N^2) sum |d(xi,xj)^0.5 - d(yi,yj)^0.5|. Start lambda_vario=0.1.

name: H3: Conditional LayerNorm noise injection (AIFS-CRPS approach)
theory: AIFS-CRPS (ECMWF, operational) uses CLN under same afCRPS loss. Our Exp 120a (AdaGN) failed — but CLN modulates normalization params, different mechanism. Lambda-Skip theory: skip 4% guarantees collapse. CLN makes noise 100% of output.
prediction: Noise rank increases from 1.06 toward GT ~2.6. Cross-cell corr decreases.
falsification: noise rank < 2.0 after 10ep → 2-layer MLP too shallow even for CLN
implementation: Replace skip with CLN: h = gamma(z)*LayerNorm(h) + beta(z) after each MLP layer. gamma, beta = Linear(noise_dim, hidden_dim).
info_value: HIGH — structural guarantee via Lambda-Skip theory

name: H4: Non-AR joint generation with attention decoder
theory: AR loop processes same MLP with same noise 30 times → identical noise utilization. Literature: CSDI, Diffusion Forcing, TransFusion all show non-AR preserves diversity. 750 attention positions = 750 distinct noise pathways.
prediction: Effective rank > 2.0 under CRPS. All 3 failing suites improve.
falsification: Stage 1: MSE plateau → data too small for attention. Stage 2: rank collapses under CRPS → CRPS must be replaced entirely.
implementation: Replace AR+MLP with lightweight transformer decoder over full (30,5,5). Stage 1: MSE pretrain. Stage 2: CRPS fine-tune.
